answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with every extra identity it operates, like a trellis that only supports vines strong enough to climb it. A public beacon publishes reputation earned through verifiable work, so new identities start with zero trust and must spend real compute and time to climb. An attacker who tries to bridge trust from one identity to many finds the stake makes each fake account cost more than the reward it can extract, so mass forgery becomes unprofitable.
